name: Palacio de los Duques, a Gran Meliá Hotel
positioning: Converted 19th-century Isabeline palace in Madrid de los Austrias, between Plaza de Oriente and Gran Via, inspired by the work of Velazquez
best_for: Travelers who want a palace hotel near the Royal Palace and the Teatro Real
Guests who want club-level service through RedLevel

facts.text: The hotel is a converted 19th-century palace in an Isabeline-style building in the heart of Madrid.
It sits between Plaza de Oriente and Gran Via, in the Madrid de los Austrias district.
The hotel is inspired by the work of Velazquez.
The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
The hotel is about 0.55 km from the Royal Palace and about 1.8 km from the Prado Museum.
Jardin de los Duques has a main dining room, a private lounge and an outdoor area in the palace's historic garden.
Jardin de los Duques serves dishes inspired by Castilian tradition, bringing together sea and land flavors.
Los Duques Grand Cafe serves Mediterranean and international dishes with creative cocktails.
The hotel lists a rooftop pool among its facilities.
The hotel is pet-friendly, with a welcome gift and natural and organic amenities for pets.
RedLevel guests have exclusive access to the RedLevel Lounge, with buffet and a la carte breakfast and an Open Bar service.
RedLevel services include butler service and late check-out until 14:00, subject to availability.

highlights.text: Jardin de los Duques restaurant is set in the palace's former stables and offers three distinct settings inspired by the Madrid of the Habsburgs.
Thai Room Wellness offers Thai therapies in a setting with Burmese lacquers, Chinese antiques and Tibetan handicrafts.
The hotel is a couple of minutes' walk from the Teatro Real.
The Royal Suite has a terrace with panoramic views of the Opera and the Barrio de los Austrias.
A complimentary Luxury Van service takes guests wherever they want in the city of Madrid.

considerations.text: The hotel is near the Royal Palace, but the Prado Museum is about 1.8 km away.
The RedLevel Lounge, private breakfast and butler service are reserved for guests booking RedLevel rooms and suites.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
